areas.title: Application startup and main activity
unknowns: Full injected startup graph and experiment configuration are unresolved.

areas.title: Navigation and tabs
unknowns: Tab models, ordering and server-driven routing are not resolved.

areas.title: Home and feed architecture
unknowns: Renderer data pipeline and Home filtering controller remain obfuscated; a reusable list class is not a Home-specific entry point.

areas.title: Video player architecture
unknowns: Obfuscated method semantics, active engine selection, native dispatch and video identity ownership need additional tracing.

areas.title: Background playback components
unknowns: Entitlement decisions, audio-focus ownership and eligibility conditions are not established.

areas.title: Shorts architecture
unknowns: Shorts controller, active video lifecycle and seek behavior remain unverified.

areas.title: Captions and playback controls
unknowns: Track selection, caption availability and control action dispatch are not traced.

areas.title: Player settings and preferences
unknowns: Preference-to-playback synchronization and persistent store schemas are unresolved.

areas.title: Download-related components
unknowns: Offline entitlement, protected-content handling and transfer pipeline are not audited; no supported downloader is implemented.

areas.title: Network and API boundaries
unknowns: Actual endpoint/authentication flows, redirect policy and native transport ownership are not audited.

areas.title: SponsorBlock integration opportunities
unknowns: No native SponsorBlock integration was identified by these selectors. Reliable video ID/time/seek and consent boundaries are unproven; this is a design opportunity only.

areas.title: Logging and privacy boundaries
unknowns: Payload content, redaction, retention and all network sinks remain unverified. A privacy UI class does not prove privacy enforcement.
